default_running.observed: the initial actor graphics path assigns the running script and a direction/timing table before selecting descriptor data

descriptor_staging.descriptor_source: DATA_82:A3D7 indexed by the selected descriptor pointer
descriptor_staging.observed: the routine stages descriptor-derived transfer records and writes the VRAM-port register selector into the record; this artifact does not decode every descriptor field or claim an OAM layout

limitations: Repeated direction pointers are raw table aliases; their visual symmetry or flip behavior must not be inferred without the complete descriptor and attribute path.
This confirms default running setup only; it does not classify walking, kicks, slides, goalkeeper actions, or gameplay state transitions.
No browser animation behavior changes from this extraction alone.
